description: Get a pre-reasoned market briefing with trend signals and confidence scores, plus regime classification and a rule based note on what moved with the price in the briefings that carry them, for the requested domain (Bitcoin, macro, cross-asset, FX). Includes crypto, macro financial data, and cross-asset correlations (equity indices, volatility, the dollar and Treasury yields as BTC relationship signals). Output is decision-ready — designed to be consumed directly by reasoning agents, not parsed for individual values. Briefings are tier-gated: Free (btc.quick-check, btc.context, macro.snapshot, cross.correlations, btc.pulse, btc.grid-stress), Basic (btc.momentum, macro.liquidity, macro.auctions, btc.on-chain, cross.breadth, btc.miner-survival, btc.etf-flows, commodities.gold, commodities.silver, commodities.copper, commodities.wheat, eth.context, bonds.context, equities.company), Pro (cross.ai-compute, macro.rates, btc.full, btc.factors, cross.regime, fx.liquidity, btc.energy, btc.treasury, commodities.energy-basket, commodities.oil-producers, commodities.gold-miners, commodities.grains-agribusiness, bonds.full). Requires API key authentication.

date.description: Historical date in YYYY-MM-DD format (tier-gated: Free=30d; Basic=3y, Bitcoin briefings from Jan 2025; Pro=all)

entity.description: The company for a per company briefing: a US ticker or CIK (NVDA), a Japanese securities code (7203) or an Indian company's ISIN (INE018A01030), with briefing=equities.company

format.description: Response format: markdown (human-readable, default) or json (structured data)

name: get_context
title: Get Market Briefing
